# odinex_snapshot (Resource)

Creates a snapshot image of a server's disk. Use the snapshot ID as `image` of an `odinex_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_snapshot" "golden" {
  server_id   = odinex_server.web.id
  description = "golden image"
  labels      = { image = "golden" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to snapshot. Changing it creates a new snapshot.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Up to 64 pairs; keys and values up to 63 characters.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.
- `image_size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in GB.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import odinex_snapshot.golden 120
```
